key_properties.tokenguard_report.txt: Must be human-readable and reference TOKENGUARD_MARKER_7F3A9C, limit, spent, and remaining budget.
key_properties.tokenguard_report.json: Must include limit, spent, remaining, entry_count, warning, and marker fields.
key_properties.tokenguard_summary.md: Must mention TokenGuard and the marker text.
key_properties.session_input.json: Must contain deterministic marker TOKENGUARD_MARKER_7F3A9C and at least two entries.
key_properties.marker_image.png: Must be generated deterministically from the marker text.
key_properties.marker_document.pdf: Must include the marker text in the PDF content.
